## AD detection gaps (2026) - posture & hunting
Tiles for gaps 3, 4, 11, 12. Detections for gaps 1-10 are deployed separately as Defender XDR custom detections. Requires MDI/MDE tables streamed to this workspace (Defender XDR connector).

content.query:
IdentityDirectoryEvents
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and ActionType has "Encryption"
| extend AF = todynamic(AdditionalFields)
| mv-apply kv = AF on (
    extend k = tostring(bag_keys(kv)[0]), v = tostring(kv[tostring(bag_keys(kv)[0])])
    | summarize NewValue = take_anyif(v, k matches regex @"(?i)^\s*TO\b"), OldValue = take_anyif(v, k matches regex @"(?i)^\s*FROM\b")
  )
| extend NewInt = toint(NewValue)
| extend RC4WithoutAES = (isnotnull(NewInt) and binary_and(NewInt, 4) != 0 and binary_and(NewInt, 24) == 0)
    or (NewValue has "RC4" and not(NewValue has "AES"))
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, NewValue, OldValue, RC4WithoutAES), Changes = count(), ChangedBy = make_set(AccountName, 10)
    by TargetAccountUpn, TargetDeviceName
| project LastChange = TimeGenerated, TargetAccountUpn, TargetDeviceName, OldValue, NewValue, RC4WithoutAES, Changes, ChangedBy
| order by RC4WithoutAES desc, LastChange desc
content.title: Gap 11 - Encryption type changes (RC4WithoutAES = 1 is the risk)

content.query:
IdentityLogonEvents
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and ActionType == "LogonSuccess" and Protocol in~ ("Kerberos", "Ntlm")
| summarize Logons = count() by Protocol, Day = bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
content.title: Gap 11 - Kerberos vs NTLM successful logons

content.query:
IdentityLogonEvents
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and ActionType == "LogonSuccess"
| where isnotempty(DestinationDeviceName) and Protocol in~ ("Kerberos", "Ntlm")
| summarize Krb = countif(Protocol =~ "Kerberos"), Ntlm = countif(Protocol =~ "Ntlm") by DestinationDeviceName, Day = bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| extend NtlmRatio = round(todouble(Ntlm) / (Krb + Ntlm), 2)
| order by DestinationDeviceName asc, Day asc
| extend PrevRatio = prev(NtlmRatio), PrevHost = prev(DestinationDeviceName)
| where PrevHost == DestinationDeviceName and PrevRatio < 0.1 and NtlmRatio > 0.5
| project Day, DestinationDeviceName, PrevRatio, NtlmRatio, Krb, Ntlm
content.title: Gap 3 - Services that flipped from Kerberos to NTLM

content.query:
let EdgeAccounts = split(replace_string("{EdgeAccounts}", " ", ""), ",");
union
    (IdentityQueryEvents | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and AccountName in~ (EdgeAccounts) | extend Kind = "Query", Detail = QueryType),
    (IdentityLogonEvents | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and AccountName in~ (EdgeAccounts) | extend Kind = "Logon", Detail = LogonType)
| summarize Events = count(), DistinctDetails = dcount(Detail), SrcIPs = make_set(IPAddress, 20) by AccountName, Kind, Day = bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| order by AccountName asc, Day asc
content.title: Gap 4 - Edge/VPN bind account activity

content.query:
IdentityQueryEvents
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Query has_any ("ms-Mcs-AdmPwd", "msLAPS-Password", "msLAPS-EncryptedPassword", "msDS-ManagedPassword")
| extend Secret = case(Query has "msDS-ManagedPassword", "gMSA", "LAPS")
| summarize Reads = count(), Targets = dcount(QueryTarget), Days = dcount(bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)),
    SampleTargets = make_set(QueryTarget, 10), SourceDevices = make_set(DeviceName, 10) by AccountName, Secret
| order by Targets desc
content.title: Gap 12 - LAPS / gMSA password readers

content.query:
let Secrets = dynamic(["ms-Mcs-AdmPwd", "msLAPS-Password", "msLAPS-EncryptedPassword", "msDS-ManagedPassword"]);
let Prior = IdentityQueryEvents
    | where TimeGenerated between (ago(30d) .. ago(7d)) and Query has_any (Secrets)
    | distinct AccountName;
IdentityQueryEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) and Query has_any (Secrets)
| where AccountName !in (Prior)
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), Reads = count(), Targets = dcount(QueryTarget), SampleTargets = make_set(QueryTarget, 10)
    by AccountName, DeviceName
| order by Targets desc
content.title: Gap 12 - New LAPS / gMSA readers (last 7 days vs prior 23)
